prompt: i have just got a new puppy. how should i train it to walk on a leash? give me step by step instructions
response: To train your puppy to walk on a leash, start by letting them get used to the leash by dragging it around while they play. Once they seem comfortable, attach the leash to their collar and let them drag it around for a few more minutes. Gradually introduce the concept of walking by your side, but don't worry too much about pulling. Puppies will learn at their own pace, so be patient and make it a fun experience.
